ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you read the syllable نِ? (1 mark)
   A. buu
   B. la
   C. muu
   D. ni

2. Which word do you use for 'This is ...' before a feminine word such as shams? (1 mark)
   A. man
   B. haadhaa
   C. ayna
   D. haadhihi

3. Which Arabic word means "school"? (1 mark)
   A. الثُّلَاثَاءُ
   B. الْأَحَدُ
   C. مَدْرَسَةٌ
   D. أُسْبُوعٌ

4. Which of these is a position word? (1 mark)
   A. sariir
   B. kitaab
   C. ʿinda
   D. qalam

5. Which Arabic room word is made from the words ghurfa and nawm? (1 mark)
   A. the kitchen
   B. the bathroom
   C. the garden
   D. the bedroom

6. What does the Arabic sentence هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like bananas.
   B. Do you like bananas?
   C. I eat bread.
   D. I drink water.

7. Which Arabic word means "heart"? (1 mark)
   A. ظَهْرٌ
   B. وَجْهٌ
   C. أُذُنٌ
   D. قَلْبٌ

8. Which sentence is the best beginning of a paragraph about your house? (1 mark)
   A. al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila
   B. uhibbu baytii
   C. fii l-matbakhi taawila
   D. haadhaa baytii

9. Which of these is true about the Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. It has capital and small letters
   B. It has no capital letters
   C. It is read from left to right
   D. It has only 20 letters

10. Which of these Arabic words (in English letters) means 'clouds'? (1 mark)
   A. shams
   B. riih
   C. matar
   D. ghaym

11. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا مِنْ كينيا mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am a pupil (boy).
   B. My name is Ahmad.
   C. I am a pupil (girl).
   D. I am from Kenya.

12. Which Arabic sentence means "The chair is new." (1 mark)
   A. النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ
   B. الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ
   C. الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ
   D. الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ

13. What does tone mean in public speaking? (1 mark)
   A. The length of the speech
   B. The size of the audience
   C. The colour of your clothes
   D. How your voice sounds, for example friendly and clear

14. How is the Arabic word صَدِيقٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. dawrii
   B. sadiiq
   C. kaʿka
   D. dawruka

15. What should you write on the back of a body flashcard? (1 mark)
   A. The sound and the meaning
   B. A long story
   C. Nothing
   D. Only your name

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain why dots are important in Arabic letters. Give an example. (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Explain why correct spelling is important in Arabic. (2 marks) (2 marks)

18. Translate into English: akhii yalʿabu (2 marks)

19. Translate into English: ummii tatbukhu T-taʿaam (2 marks)

20. Put these syllables in order to make a family word and give its meaning: khaa + lun. (2 marks) (2 marks)

21. Translate into English: haadhaa raʾsii (2 marks)

22. Translate into English: man haadhaa? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — ni
   نِ is read ni.

2. D — haadhihi
   haadhihi is used with feminine words and haadhaa with masculine words.

3. C — مَدْرَسَةٌ
   مَدْرَسَةٌ (madrasa) means school.

4. C — ʿinda
   ʿinda means at. The other words are things.

5. D — the bedroom
   ghurfatu n-nawm means 'the room of sleep', which is the bedroom.

6. B — Do you like bananas?
   هَلْ تُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ؟ (hal tuhibbu l-mawz?) means: Do you like bananas?

7. D — قَلْبٌ
   قَلْبٌ (qalb) means heart.

8. D — haadhaa baytii
   haadhaa baytii (This is my house) introduces the topic.

9. B — It has no capital letters
   Arabic has one style for each letter and no capitals.

10. D — ghaym
   ghaym means clouds.

11. D — I am from Kenya.
   أَنَا مِنْ كينيا (anaa min Kiiniya) means: I am from Kenya.

12. C — الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ
   الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ (al-kursiyyu jadiid) means: The chair is new.

13. D — How your voice sounds, for example friendly and clear
   Tone is the sound quality of your voice, such as calm, friendly and clear.

14. B — sadiiq
   صَدِيقٌ is read sadiiq and means friend.

15. A — The sound and the meaning
   The Arabic word is on the front. The back has the sound and the meaning.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Some letters have the same body shape and differ only by their dots. For example baa has one dot below, taa has two dots above and thaa has three dots above.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for same shape, 1 mark for dots make the difference and 1 mark for a correct example.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: A missing letter or a wrong dot can change the word, so the reader may not understand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a change in the word and 1 mark for understanding.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: My brother plays.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: My mother cooks the food.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: khaa-lun (mother's brother).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct order and 1 mark for the meaning.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my head.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Who is this? (a boy or man)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
